hideHint: Hide from future wallpapers in Pinpaper. Pinterest is not changed.
getStarted: Choose pictures on Pinterest. Let Pinpaper take care of your wallpaper.
selectedEmpty: Choose a collection and add pictures in Settings first.
signInGuide: Open Pinterest and sign in. Complete any verification, then return here.
privateHint: Closing Pinterest ends your sign-in session. Your added pictures stay saved.
homeGuide: Open Pinterest Home, scroll and let your pictures load. Return here with the Pinterest window still open.
savedGuide: Open your profile → Saved → a board. Scroll to individual pins and let them load. Return here with the window still open.
addGuide: Add up to 200 pictures loaded on the open page. To add more, scroll in Pinterest and import again. You can then close its window.
addedNotice: Pictures saved. Go back and choose Change wallpaper.
retryHelp: Open Pinterest, let your pictures load, then add them again.
collectionsHint: Check collections and apply your selection. Pinterest imports share one collection.
pictureCounts: Pictures: {total} total · {selected} selected · {available} match the saved filters · {unknown} need a size check · {hidden} hidden.
noCollections: No collection is selected. Wallpaper changes need at least one.
selectionApplied: Selection applied for your next wallpaper.
useAllPicturesHint: Selects every collection and clears filters. Hidden pictures stay hidden. Save settings to apply.
allPicturesPrepared: All collections selected and filters cleared. Save settings to apply.
wordsHint: Separate words with commas. Matches pin titles and descriptions, not image contents.
scheduleHint: Uses your computer’s time. Equal start and stop times mean all day. Closing the window keeps changes running; quitting Pinpaper stops them.
launchAtLogin: Launch Pinpaper when I sign in
launchAtLoginHint: Pinpaper will start with the system. Turn this off here to remove it from startup.
accountHint: Sign out closes Pinterest. Reset removes Pinpaper pictures and settings. Your Pinterest account stays unchanged.
resetConfirm: Remove all pictures and settings saved in Pinpaper? Your Pinterest account will not be changed.
resetDone: Pinpaper was reset. Add pictures again to import their current dimensions.
errorResetCache: The pictures and settings were reset, but the image cache could not be fully removed. Try Reset again.
galleryHint: Open pins on Pinterest or hide them from wallpapers. You can restore hidden pictures anytime.
noMatches: No pictures match. Try another search or show hidden pictures.
noPictures: No pictures yet. Add some from Pinterest in Settings.
errorNoPage: Open Pinterest from step 1, sign in, and open Home or a saved board before adding pictures.
errorNoPins: Scroll down in the Pinterest window and wait for pictures to load, then try adding them again.
errorFilters: Choose a collection in Settings or relax the picture filters, then try again.
previewOnly: Preview · actions available in the desktop app
browserTitle: Pinterest — sign in and load pictures
minWidthHelp: A lower width allows more pictures, but they may look less sharp on a large screen.
errorForbidden: This picture is unavailable. Choose Change wallpaper to try another. If this continues, add your Pinterest pictures again.
retrySearch: No suitable wallpaper found. Try again. If this continues, relax the filters or add your Pinterest pictures again.
